279786018.description:
Hyman Products, Inc.
Authentic Berlin Wall and Lava Rock Lot
Vintage, 1989
This commemorative set features authentic segments including a piece of the Berlin Wall, preserved following the historic events of late 1989. The lot includes the original presentation box, a velvet drawstring pouch, an informative historical booklet, and a formal Declaration of Origin document. These artifacts represent a significant turning point in 20th-century history, documenting the transition from the Cold War to German reunification.
ITEMS INCLUDED:
1.
Berlin Wall Segment
- Authentic concrete cut with visible aggregate, originated in East Germany
2.
Lava Rock Piece
- Naturally textured specimen as identified in collection records
3.
Documentation
- Original 1989 Declaration of Origin and historical booklet
4.
Presentation Materials
- Original Hyman Products box and burgundy velvet drawstring pouch
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. Rock specimens are intact with natural textures. Documentation and booklet are well-preserved with minor age-toning. The original cardboard box shows light shelf wear and a partial surface tear near the barcode area. Velvet pouch is clean and functional.

279946287.description:
Bendos Action Figure Lot - 5 Figures and Accessories
Kid Galaxy, Vintage 1999-2000
3 Sealed In Tubes, 2 Loose
This collection features five bendable figures from Kid Galaxy's popular Bendos line, which dominated the poseable toy market in the late 1990s and early 2000s. Known for their distinct minimalist face designs and wire-core flexibility, Bendos are sought after for their unique aesthetic. This lot includes three factory-sealed figures in original cylindrical packaging and two loose figures with character-specific accessories.
Figures Included:
Mega-Parachute Bendo - Sealed in large tube #604, includes red parachute.
Santa Bendo - Sealed in tube #270, includes green toy sack accessory.
Diamond Softball Player - Sealed in tube #103, includes baseball bat.
Scuba Diver and Tech Figure - Loose figures with "Kid Galaxy" markings.
Accessories: Diving helmet, daisy acoustic guitar, two money bags, and snowboard.
Condition:
Three figures are factory sealed in original plastic tubes; tubes show light shelf wear and minor scuffing. Loose figures show minor paint rubs consistent with light use but retain full poseability. All included accessories are in good vintage condition with vibrant colors and no structural damage.
